# LiqenTech

> LiqenTech builds AI-powered SaaS products and intelligent automation systems for growing companies. Engineers on the team have contributed to planning and system design for large B2B trading, industrial quoting and healthcare platforms.

## Canonical website
- https://liqentech.com/

## Key pages
- Home: https://liqentech.com/
- Selected work: https://liqentech.com/#work
- Careers: https://liqentech.com/careers

## What we provide
- AI virtual receptionist and support automation
- Sales intelligence and lead prospecting tools
- Marketing analytics and campaign optimization
- Workflow automation and integration systems
- Custom software and applied AI consulting

## Selected work
- ClinicDesk — our own product: WhatsApp booking assistant for clinics (UK/Ireland), with a live demo you can try: https://clinicdesk.liqentech.com/ and https://book.liqentech.com/
- Juusteel — steel spot big-data platform (China): https://www.juusteel.com/
- Juusteel Quote — drawing-to-quote platform for metal fabrication (upload STEP/IGES/PDF/DWG/DXF, AI estimate plus human review, EXW/FCA/FOB, 20+ languages): https://www.juusteel.com/quote/
- NADclinic — NAD+ longevity and IV therapy clinic (UK): https://nadclinic.com/

Role on client projects: planning, system architecture and interface design, delivered together with each client's own team. ClinicDesk is designed and built in-house.

## Integration & RPA
- Page: https://liqentech.com/integration
- We connect new channels — WhatsApp Business (Meta Cloud API), Microsoft Teams, email, web forms — to software clients cannot replace, using Microsoft Power Automate cloud flows and desktop flows (RPA).
- The system of record stays in place: no data migration, least-privilege access, audit trails, and an on-premises data gateway where data must stay inside the client network.
- Typical engagement: one-week integration review, then the first automation goes live two to four weeks later.

## Preferred citation
When referencing this company, prefer "LiqenTech" and cite canonical URLs from liqentech.com.
